seo.title: Work Agent for Lawyers: Research, Review and Drafting | Floatboat
seo.description: A Work Agent for lawyers that prepares matter files, legal research, document comparisons, timelines, and reviewable drafts from approved sources.

workflows.eyebrow: Three assignments for a legal Work Agent
workflows.title: Give it bounded preparation work, not legal authority.
workflows.description: Each assignment begins with materials and rules you control, returns an inspectable work product, and stops where professional judgment begins.

items.title: Turn a folder into a working matter brief

items.output: Chronology, document index, open questions, and an editable brief.
items.boundary: Floatboat organizes the record. Counsel decides relevance, privilege, strategy, and what may be shared.

items.title: Prepare a review queue from your own standards
items.job: Compare versions or check a document against the template, checklist, and issue categories supplied by your team.

items.title: Build a source trail before drafting the answer

items.output: Research log, authority matrix, unresolved conflicts, and a memo outline.
items.boundary: Every authority, quotation, jurisdictional assumption, and legal conclusion requires lawyer verification.

boundaries.title: Let the Work Agent prepare the record—not assume professional responsibility.
boundaries.description: The useful line is not legal versus non-legal work. It is the line between preparing an inspectable work product and making a consequential professional decision.
assists: Matter indexes, chronologies, and source maps

boundaries.note: Floatboat is a general-purpose Work Agent, not a law firm, legal research authority, or substitute for qualified legal counsel. It works inside a persistent workspace; data handling depends on the models, tools, connectors, permissions, and policies selected for that environment.

faq.title: Work Agent questions for lawyers
faq.description: The practical questions are about source material, review, confidentiality, and control—not promises of one-click legal work.

items.question: Is Floatboat legal AI or a law-practice management system?
items.answer: Floatboat is a general-purpose Work Agent. It can prepare work from approved files, research materials, templates, and repeatable instructions, but it is not a legal authority, matter-management system, billing platform, or substitute for counsel.

items.question: Can Floatboat review a contract?
items.answer: It can extract terms, compare versions, apply a checklist or template you provide, and prepare deviations and questions for review. A lawyer still determines legal meaning, risk, negotiation position, and whether any recommendation is appropriate.

items.question: Can it do legal research without hallucinations?
items.answer: No AI system should be treated as incapable of error. Floatboat can help structure research, organize sources, and create a traceable packet, but every authority, quotation, jurisdictional assumption, and conclusion must be verified against authoritative sources.

items.question: Does Floatboat come with a built-in law-firm playbook?
items.answer: The page examples are starting points, not prescribed legal methods. You choose the files, templates, checklists, terminology, output format, and approval steps appropriate to your firm, client, matter, and jurisdiction.

items.question: Can I use my own templates and checklists?
items.answer: Yes. Give the Work Agent the materials, instructions, and output structure you approve. Its persistent workspace keeps those inputs connected to the assignment instead of forcing a generic legal format.

items.question: How should privileged or confidential material be handled?
items.answer: Follow your firm's policies and client obligations before adding sensitive material. Review the data handling of every model, connector, and tool used in the workflow, scope access narrowly, and do not assume that local file access means every processing step remains on-device.

items.question: Will Floatboat send client messages or file documents automatically?
items.answer: The recommended workflows keep consequential external actions behind explicit human approval. Whether a connector can perform an action is separate from whether your policy should permit it.

items.question: Who is this page for?
items.answer: The examples are relevant to lawyers, in-house counsel, paralegals, legal operations teams, and other legal professionals who spend time preparing files, context, drafts, and repeatable work products.

finalCta.title: Prepare the matter; keep the legal call yours.
finalCta.description: Use a bounded matter folder and a trusted template to prepare one reviewable document. A qualified professional remains responsible for the legal conclusions.
